entries.claim:
Deployment privilege preflight is implemented in `worker-database-privileges.mjs`
and invoked through the deployment controller. Its extraction preserves the same
production-only worker credential check, allowed privileges and fail-closed
validation before slot activation. Worker document-adapter selection and release
argument parsing remain inside their existing process/CLI boundaries.

Deployment tooling keeps worker privilege queries and assertions in a focused
local module, called by the deployment controller; those checks do not grant
application services SQL or deployment authority. The accounting participant
keeps observation construction private to its existing transaction boundary.
Frontend panel, field-policy and presentation extractions remain inside their
owning slices; they introduce no new app, layer or cross-slice relationship.

The worker document-adapter helper retains the configured deterministic or
production adapter selection; it adds no process, storage service or external
provider. Knowledge HTTP error mapping remains within the same authenticated
and capability-aware router. These local readability changes leave the system
relationships shown above unchanged.
